summary: Frontend E2E for the split marketing sites (iter 464). ALL requested flows PASS. '/' renders MyHotelBox PMS landing (light theme) with every requested data-testid present (nav-link-reveniq, hero-*, feature-*, reveniq-crosssell, crosssell-reveniq-btn, pricing-*, footer-reveniq-link, landing-signin-btn). '/reveniq' renders ReveniQ RMS site (dark theme) with rq-nav-link-myhotelbox, rq-hero-mockup, rq-feature-0..7, rq-step-0..2, rq-testimonial-0..2, rq-pricing-essentials/pro/enterprise, faq-item-0 (expands), rq-footer-mhb-link, rq-signin-btn. Cross-nav both directions works. Demo forms: PMS submits with product='pms', RMS submits with product='rms' (verified via intercepted POST payloads to /api/public/demo-requests); both show demo-form-success. Invalid email now shows sonner toast 'Please enter a valid work email' and correctly suppresses the success state — the iter 463 cosmetic gap is FIXED. Admin panel: login OK, nav-section-Guests → demo-leads-btn → DemoLeadsPanel shows both leads with correct product badges ('MyHotelBox' green for pms, 'ReveniQ' dark for rms). Regression: authenticated '/' shows dashboard (not landing), public /book/default booking widget loads. Test leads cleaned up (2 deleted, 200 responses).
critical_code_review_comments: shared.js DemoForm: noValidate + JS regex email check + sonner toast is a clean, consistent replacement for the previous HTML5-only validation. Product field is passed via props (pms/rms) and correctly serialized in the POST body.
LandingPage.js and ReveniqLanding.js correctly namespace their data-testids (nav-* vs rq-*) so cross-page selectors never collide — good for E2E.
DemoLeadsPanel product badge uses data-testid=demo-lead-product-{id} with distinct color per product — matches spec and renders correctly for both pms/rms records.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 demo requests during the run (Bad Email Test/pms, TEST RMS Lead 464/rms) — both DELETED at end (HTTP 200). DB clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DemoForm inputs use data-testid selectors ONLY (demo-form-name, demo-form-email, demo-form-hotel, demo-form-rooms, demo-form-message, demo-form-submit) — they do NOT have HTML 'name' attributes, so name-based selectors will time out. Invalid email is now blocked via JS regex + sonner toast (not HTML5). Sidebar 'Guests' section still starts collapsed; click nav-section-Guests before demo-leads-btn. Cleanup endpoint DELETE /api/demo-requests/{id} works with credentials:'include'.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Iter 463's cosmetic invalid-email note is now resolved.
